source.title: Critical nonconformities identified at a drinking-water and lemonade production facility

interpretation_limits: This is an official regulatory-inspection report, not a laboratory water-quality result.

The source reports critical hygiene and infrastructure nonconformities and suspension of the production process; it does not publish water sample counts, analyte values, methods or a tested-sample denominator.
The record must not be interpreted as proof of microbiological or chemical contamination, population exposure, or prevalence across Zugdidi or Georgia.
Business name, street address, tax identifier and personal data are intentionally excluded from this public research metadata.
